title: APPENDIX C, Table 1 — City Environmental Quality Review (CEQR) Environmental Requirements: (E) Designations
previewText:
CITY ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY REVIEW (CEQR) ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Table 1 – (E) Designations

Tax lot changes that may have occurred since the establishment of a particular (E) Designation may not be reflected in this table. blocks.html: Tax lot changes that may have occurred since the establishment of a particular (E) Designation may not be reflected in this table.  If the property in question is located on the same tax block as an (E) designation, review of the related CEQR documentation is recommended.  For convenience, for (E) designations applied to a condominium, the condominium billing tax lot number is displayed instead of the individual condominium unit tax lot numbers.
blocks.plainText: Tax lot changes that may have occurred since the establishment of a particular (E) Designation may not be reflected in this table. If the property in question is located on the same tax block as an (E) designation, review of the related CEQR documentation is recommended. For convenience, for (E) designations applied to a condominium, the condominium billing tax lot number is displayed instead of the individual condominium unit tax lot numbers.

blocks.html: Application No. – refers to a ULURP or non-ULURP application (containing six numbers followed by a three- or four-letter suffix) for a zoning text map or text amendment, special permit, authorization, or certification or to a Board of Standards and Appeals application (containing the letters “BZ”) for a special permit or variance.
blocks.plainText: Application No. – refers to a ULURP or non-ULURP application (containing six numbers followed by a three- or four-letter suffix) for a zoning text map or text amendment, special permit, authorization, or certification or to a Board of Standards and Appeals application (containing the letters “BZ”) for a special permit or variance.

blocks.html: Lot Remediation Date – refers to the date of the duly issued notice from the NYC Office of Environmental Remediation indicating that no investigative/remedial work is required for any current or future development of the lot.
blocks.plainText: Lot Remediation Date – refers to the date of the duly issued notice from the NYC Office of Environmental Remediation indicating that no investigative/remedial work is required for any current or future development of the lot.
